description: This file defines a React functional component 'ChangeEditorMenu' that renders a menu for switching between different editor components or note types within a web application. It includes logic for handling user interactions, selecting components, opening importers, and managing state related to editor selection.

methods.name: getGroupId
methods.description: Generates a CSS ID string for a menu group based on its title.

methods.name: selectComponent
methods.description: Handles the selection of an editor component, updating the note and current component accordingly.

methods.name: selectNonComponent
methods.description: Handles selection of a note type that isn't associated with a specific editor component.

methods.name: selectItem
methods.description: Main handler for selecting a menu item, manages entitlement checks, conflicts, modal prompts, and invokes component or note-type changes.

methods.name: handleSuperNoteConversionCompletion
methods.description: Callback invoked after importing or converting a note to a super note, updating state accordingly.

methods.name: closeSuperNoteImporter
methods.description: Closes the super note import modal.
